agent_notes: The change only adds output escaping. It wraps three existing logger.debug arguments (Model.add_file, Model.remove_file and Model.update_file in /Users/julianamacbook/seedsyncarr/src/python/model/model.py) in the existing helper sanitize_log_value from /Users/julianamacbook/seedsyncarr/src/python/common/types.py:17, which is re-exported at common/__init__.py:1. This tightens CWE-117 log injection protection and is presumptively safe on that axis.

Public API: no signatures change. add_file, remove_file and update_file keep the same parameters, return values and ModelError raise behavior. The membership check and dict key still use the raw file.name or filename, so model lookups, diffs (model/diff.py), serialization (web/serialize/serialize_model.py) and streaming (web/handler/stream_model.py) are untouched. Only the debug log text changes.

Blast radius: one module edited. model.py is imported by 10 files (controller.py, auto_queue.py, model_builder.py, file_operation_manager.py, extract/dispatch.py, extract/extract_process.py, model/__init__.py, model/diff.py, stream_model.py, serialize_model.py), and none of them depend on the log text. The only behavior that differs is DEBUG output for filenames containing C0 control characters or DEL, which are now escaped. Log parsers or tests that match raw newlines in these three messages would see different text. This is the intended effect, and the RED commit 7035477 adds tests for it.

Import risk: the new import is a name already exported from the common package, and other modules (controller.py in commit 45ff4bd) already import it the same way, so it adds no new circular-import exposure.

Performance: sanitize_log_value now runs on every add, remove or update, even when DEBUG is disabled, because the argument is evaluated before logger.debug checks the level. Before this change .format() was already evaluated eagerly, so the extra cost is one linear scan per filename. Model updates happen once per scan cycle per file, and the cost is negligible at expected file counts of thousands or fewer. This is not a finding: there is no unbounded mechanism.
Type safety: file.name and filename are str everywhere in the model contract (ModelFile.name). The helper's docstring and signature only cover str input, and no caller passes None.
No database, schema or migration impact.
Verdict: shippable as-is. There are no breaking-API, schema or scale concerns.
